iam06.title: Issue a pairing code
iam06.meta: You pair a device by reading a code to the installer. Each code works once, within 15 minutes of issue.
iam06.codeLabel: Read this code to the installer
iam06.once: Shown once. It is not stored and cannot be shown again.
iam06.purposeInvalid: This purpose is no longer approved. Choose another and send again.
iam06.formNote: The code works once, within 15 minutes of issue. It is shown once, as soon as it is issued.
iam06.emptyTitle: No pairing code has been issued for this premises.
iam06.dlgText: Once it is revoked, no device can pair with it. To pair a device, issue a new code.
iam06.reasonMissing: Enter a reason and send again.
iam06.doneText: No device can pair with it.
iam06.refusal.PAIRING_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDE: Too many pairing attempts have been made from here.
Wait ten minutes and try again. The message is the same whether or not the code was right.
iam06.refusal.CONTACT_CHANNEL_NOT_VERIFI: This action needs a verified contact address.
Verify your address with the identity provider, then try again.
iam06.refusal.AUTHORITY_NOT_IN_FORCE.tit: You do not hold the authority this action needs, or it is not in force today.
iam06.refusal.AUTHORITY_NOT_IN_FORCE.tex: Authority needed: premises principal of {premises}. Ask its owner to check the period and the scope.
iam06.refusal.FIELD_INVALID.title: One of the values sent is not valid.
iam06.refusal.FIELD_INVALID.text: Correct the marked field below and send again.
iam06.refusal.FIELD_MISSING.title: A required value is missing.
iam06.refusal.FIELD_MISSING.text: Enter a reason for the revocation and send again.
iam06.refusal.PAIRING_AUTHORISATION_CONS: That pairing code has already been used.
Ask the premises for a new code. A code works once.
iam06.refusal.PAIRING_AUTHORISATION_EXPI: That pairing code is no longer valid.
Ask the premises for a new code. A code lasts 15 minutes.
